JMFC, NANJANGUD, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA  ORAL JUDGMENT
No representation on appellants side on call.
The appeal was filed in the month of August 2024 and till now office objections are not complied.
In the light of non compliance of office objections and as there is no representation on appellants side, this Court considers that the appellants are not interested in pursuing the matter.
Therefore, the appeal stands dismissed for non prosecution.
